transport.raw_length_scope: qlog raw.length: received1RTT response STREAM QUIC packet bytes; short-header packet is final in UDP datagram; no independent wire capture

convergence.near_target_rule: non-PING response STREAM packet >ceiling-128, after client ACK of a ceiling-sized PING+PADDING packet
convergence.proof_limit: Client observations only. ACK transmission is observed, not server reception/internal discovered PMTU state. Source retains ACK-validated discovery. qlog raw.length is QUIC packet bytes, not IP fragment/syscall count.
convergence.time_unit: milliseconds, qlog0.3 relative time from trace reference; event order breaks equal timestamps
